# Awesome AI Model Showcases

Awesome AI Model Showcases collects real public production cases from the latest large models (Claude Fable 5.2 / Mythos 5.2, Gemini 4 Argon / Carbon, GPT-6.2 Sol, Grok, Qwen, DeepSeek, and others) and from the previous generation that is still mainstream: GIFs, animations, HTML and game demos, and images, with creator credits, source links, available prompts or explicit missing markers, and recorded methods.

中文：AI 模型制作案例集收录最新一代大模型（Claude Fable 5.2 / Mythos 5.2、Gemini 4 Argon / Carbon、GPT-6.2 Sol、Grok、Qwen、DeepSeek 等）以及上一代仍在主流使用的模型的真实制作案例：动图、动画、HTML / 游戏 demo、图像；保留原帖、作者、可获得的提示词或未公开标记，以及已记录的做法。

Independent community project. Organized by model family, then version. Current public inventory, not exhaustive. Author claim ≠ official verification.

## What is this repository?
A sourced catalog of real production cases from the latest large models: animations, HTML and game demos, images, and source-linked videos; only explicitly approved media is embedded. Each record keeps the post, author, prompt-or-empty, model evidence, pipeline, verification, and license boundary. The GPT Image 2.6 GIF archive is a subproject at collections/gpt-image-gifs/ and is not part of the homepage total.

## What is in the current inventory?
Homepage total 183 frontier-family cases: Claude 146, Gemini 6, GPT-6.2 Sol 14, Grok 11, Qwen 3, DeepSeek 3. GPT Image subproject 51 (X 25 + web GIF 20 + in-repo 2 + game author-claim 4), listed only under collections/gpt-image-gifs/. GPT-6.2 Sol is the owner catalog label; OpenAI public pages still list GPT-6.1 Sol. Claude Mythos 5.2 is named in the inventory and has no separate sourced case. Pending 12. Prompt-only 1. Excluded 9. Appendix 50. Seeds 6. Officially verified 2.6 game outputs: 0. One JSON source: docs/data/community-cases.json. English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese READMEs share the homepage inventory. Showcase collection sites: playbooks/research/showcase-collection-sites.json. Related GitHub projects: docs/related-projects.md. Case index: docs/showcase-index.md and data/showcase-index.json. Failed video downloads: docs/missing-videos.md.

## What can I do with it?
Inspect eight separately licensed source works at licensed-gallery.en.html (also zh-CN, zh-TW, ja and ko), with large still images, work-type labels, source and permission links. These supplemental works do not increase the main catalog count.
Browse https://jammyfu.github.io/awesome-ai-model-showcases/?lang=en (EN) or ?lang=zh (中文). Open local media and published prompts or labeled excerpts under docs/cases/<id>/. Follow source licenses and provenance notes. Original URLs are citations. Submit cases. Do not treat SVG concept covers or prompt_adaptation as originals.

## What can it not do?
No Images API at browse time. No paid generation. No blanket author-grant or CC0 claim. No exhaustive-web or official-verification claim. Appendix idea/popular pages are Chinese-first and not a second inventory.

## Which languages are maintained?
English README.md, Simplified Chinese README.zh-CN.md (AI 模型制作案例集), Traditional Chinese README.zh-TW.md, Japanese README.ja.md, and Korean README.ko.md. Same inventory and the same case counts. Case titles, methods, verification notes, model evidence and collected prompts have five-language AI translations marked not human-reviewed, with originals preserved. See docs/translation-policy.md and docs/data/translation-coverage.json. The web catalog is English/Simplified Chinese (`?lang=en` / `?lang=zh`); translated-case.html supports all five content languages.

## License boundaries
MIT covers source code only. Third-party media remains license-unknown unless a specific source grant is recorded. Follow per-case attribution; no blanket grant or CC0 claim.
